title: Excavation
mission: The storage area 'sandbox/clutter' is full of junk. Create the directory 'sandbox/secure_vault', move 'sandbox/clutter/secret_key.txt' into it, and clean up all remaining debris and empty directories in 'sandbox/clutter' using 'rm' and 'rmdir'. Run './verify_vault' to reveal the flag!
hint: Use 'man -k <keyword>' for keyword based searches. Search man pages for keywords like directories / make / remove
